description: A Link represents a connection or reference to an external resource (like a URL) or another internal entity within the system. It allows associating related information or documents with primary entities such as Partners, Projects, or Contacts.

endpoints.name: GetLinks
endpoints.description: Retrieves a list of links associated with a specific entity and its unique identifier. This endpoint supports pagination to manage large result sets.

entity.description: The type of entity the links are associated with (e.g., 'Partner', 'Project', 'Contact').

entityId.description: The unique identifier of the entity for which to retrieve links.

parameters.description: Pagination parameters such as page number, page size, and sorting options.

example_uses: Get all links associated with Partner ID 123.
List the first 10 links for Project 456.
Find all external resources linked to Contact 789.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to retrieve a list of links that are related to a specific business entity (e.g., Partner, Project, Contact) and its unique ID, optionally with pagination.

endpoints.name: Create
endpoints.description: Creates a new link record in the system. This allows associating a new external resource or internal reference with an existing entity.

req.description: The request body containing the details for the new link, such as its URL, description, and the entity it's associated with.

example_uses: Create a new link for a partner's website.
Add a document link to a project's resources.
Register a new external reference for a contact.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to establish a new connection or reference, such as a URL or document, and associate it with a specific entity in the system.

endpoints.name: Update
endpoints.description: Updates an existing link record. This allows modifying the details of a previously created link.

req.description: The request body containing the updated details for the link, including its ID and any fields to be modified.

example_uses: Update the URL of an existing link.
Modify the description of a link.
Change the entity an existing link is associated with.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to modify the properties or details of an already existing link record.

endpoints.name: Delete
endpoints.description: Deletes a link record from the system using its unique identifier.

id.description: The unique identifier of the link to be deleted.

example_uses: Remove a specific link from the system.
Can you delete the link that was created yesterday?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to permanently remove a specific link record from the system using its unique identifier.
